answer: Shards are assigned from the beacon graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The dune assignment is published and umber records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1680 identities would post 3833 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
